verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation or statements about opting out of AI/model training on user data, Copilot data usage policies, or any privacy controls specific to preventing training use; it only covers app/bot development, export APIs, and general community complaints unrelated to AI training data policy. Missing for 10: any documentation of data usage/training opt-out settings, Copilot/AI training data policy statements, admin controls for excluding tenant data from model training.
